name: Amazon PAAPI5
description: Integrates with the Amazon Product Advertising API V5 (product data / affiliate).
project_description:
Amazon drops support for the PAAPI at the end of January 2026. 
 The new API is the Creator API: https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/creatorsapi 
 Old credentials will not wo0rk, you need to generate new for the Creator API 
 I updated the module to use the new api with branch 3.x 
 All other versions will not work no more! 
 
 I myself, marcoka, use the 3.0.0 in production now.

Attention: The current 3.x version will lead to WSOD on some admin pages.

I am investigating right now, but i still use it in production because it has no effect on the frontend.

 

 
 There is no repository for the amazon SDK 
 You need to install it manually, see install.txt 
 
 Legacy information and docs 
 Upgrade Drupal 9 to 10 
 Read this: https://www.drupal.org/forum/support/module-development-and-code-questi… 

To update i needed to remove the module with composer. Not uninstall just remove or your data is gone!

From Drupal 10 we use a new repository. See composer.json inside the module folder.

Remove any SDKs you manually put inside the module or the libraries folder.

 Install the Amazon SDK 
 This module uses the official amazon php SDK that can be found here : https://webservices.amazon.com/paapi5/documentation/quick-start/using-s… 

It uses libraries support, READ the INSTALL.txt! 

 It turns out there is a guzzle dependecy problem and if we update to the latest sdk we get dependecy war BUT can not update because drupal core D9 doesnt use the latest guzzle. So you HAVE TO USE THE REPOSITORY DWW SET UP! 

 Manual install of the SDK 
 THIS DOES NOT APPLY no more cince beta16 

 Is required for the latest dev i will publish in a few days but will also work in general.

Thats how i marcoka, use it currently.

 Download the SDK 1.1 and delete everything expect the src and vendor folder!

Inside the vendor folder you can delete everything but not the composer folder and not the autoload.php

 Templates EU and US 
 EU forces us now to show prices in a special ways. The new templates reflect that. As far in the US you do not need that and the attrubutes are also not avaliable there as far as i know.

[#3282278]

For US users you can use own templates. You can use the ones from beta 11 as a starting point: https://www.drupal.org/project/amazon_pa/releases/2.1.0-beta11 

Copy them over to your theme and modify them as

you like
